lesson.subtitle: *Protein Metabolism* — XIII bo‘lim (Metabolizm va harorat boshqaruvi), PDF 819–824

simple.text: Tana quruq moddasining taxminan 3/4 qismi oqsillardir (struktura oqsillari, fermentlar, nukleoproteinlar, O2 taşuvçilar, muşak qisqaruvçi oqsillari). Aminokislotalar qon, hujayra oqsillari va plazma oqsillari örtasida doimiy, qaytar muvozanatda almaşinadi. Hujayralar tölgaç, ortiqça aminokislotalar jigarda dezaminlanadi, azot moçevina körinişida çiqariladi, uglerod skeleti esa energiya, glyukoza yoki yoğga aylanadi.

items.text: Oqsillarda 20 ta aminokislota bor. Har birida kislotali guruh (–COOH) va azot (odatda –NH2 amino guruh) böladi.

**Peptid boği:** bir aminokislotaning amino azoti boşqasining karboksil uglerodi bilan boğlanadi, H+ va OH− suv hosil qiladi. Zanjir uçlarida yana amino va karboksil guruh qoladi, şuning uçun zanjir uzayaveradi.
Eng kiçik oqsil odatda >20 aminokislota, örtaça ~400 ta; ba’zilari minglab.
Bir neçta peptid zanjirlari CO va NH guruhlari örtasidagi vodorod boğlari bilan birikadi; zanjirlar spiral yoki boşqa şaklda buklanadi.
**Qondagi aminokislotalar:** 35–65 mg/dl (har biriga örtaça ~2 mg/dl). Kuçli kislota bölgani uçun asosan ionlaşgan holda böladi va qondagi manfiy ionlarning 2–3 mEq ini taşkil qiladi.

Oşqozon-içakdan deyarli faqat aminokislotalar söriladi (polipeptid yoki butun oqsil kamdan-kam). Ovqatdan keyin qondagi daraja atigi bir neça mg/dl ga oşadi, çunki: (1) hazm/söriliş 2–3 soatga çöziladi; (2) qonga tuşgan aminokislotalar 5–10 daqiqada hujayralar, ayniqsa jigar tomonidan olinadi. Şunga qaramay almaşinuv tezligi juda yuqori: soatiga köp gramm oqsil aminokislota şaklida köçadi.
**Hujayraga kiriş:** molekulalar teşiklardan diffuziya qiliş uçun juda katta, şuning uçun faqat taşuvçilar orqali yengillaşgan yoki faol transport bilan ötadi.

**Buyrak ostonasi:** glomerulda filtrlangan aminokislotalar proksimal kanalçada ikkilamçi faol transport bilan qayta söriladi. Har bir tur uçun maksimal transport tezligi bor; plazmada juda köpayib ketsa, ortiği siydikka çiqadi.

**Hujayrada saqlaş:** aminokislotalar mRNK va ribosomalar boşqaruvida darhol oqsilga aylanadi, şuning uçun erkin aminokislota konsentratsiyasi past. Köp hujayra oqsillari lizosomal fermentlar bilan tez parçalanib, aminokislotalar qonga qaytişi mumkin. Istisno: yadro xromosoma oqsillari va struktura oqsillari (kollagen, muşak qisqaruvçi oqsillari) bu teskari jarayonda deyarli qatnaşmaydi.
Jigar (katta va maxsus tizimli) tez almaşinadigan oqsillarni köp saqlaydi; buyrak va içak şilliq qavati kamroq.
**Plazma darajasini boşqariş:** plazmadagi aminokislota kamaysa, hujayralardan çiqariladi, şu bilan har bir turning plazma konsentratsiyasi barqaror turadi.
Gormonlar: ösiş gormoni va insulin töqima oqsillarini oşiradi; glyukokortikoidlar plazma aminokislotalarini oşiradi.

Bir töqima oqsilga muhtoj bölsa, qondan oladi, qon esa boşqa hujayralar (ayniqsa jigar) oqsillari parçalanişidan töldiriladi. Saraton hujayralari aminokislotalarni köp iste’mol qiladi va boşqa hujayralar oqsillarini keskin kamaytirib qöyişi mumkin.
**Yuqori çegara:** har bir hujayra turi ma’lum miqdordan ortiq oqsil saqlay olmaydi. Hamma tölgaç, ortiqça aminokislotalar energiya uçun parçalanadi yoki yoğ/glikogenga aylanadi.
Asosiy turlari: **albumin, globulin, fibrinogen**.
Albumin — kolloid osmotik bosim, kapillyardan plazma yöqolişini oldini oladi (16-bob).
Globulinlar — fermentativ funksiyalar va tabiiy hamda orttirilgan immunitet (35-bob).
Fibrinogen — qon ivişida fibrin iplariga polimerlanadi (37-bob).
**Hosil bölişi:** deyarli barça albumin va fibrinogen hamda globulinlarning 50–80% jigarda. Qolgani (asosan gamma-globulin, antitelolar) limfoid töqimada.

Jigar 30 g/kun gaça plazma oqsili işlab çiqara oladi. Oğir kuyişda kuniga bir neça litr plazma yöqolişi, buyrak kasalligida siydik bilan oylab kuniga ~20 g oqsil yöqolişi jigar işlab çiqarişi bilan qoplanadi.
**Jigar sirrozi:** jigar hujayralari fibroz töqimaga almaşadi → plazma oqsillari sintezi kamayadi → kolloid osmotik bosim pasayadi → umumiy şiş (25-bob).

**Aminokislota manbai sifatida:** töqimalar oqsilga muhtoj bölsa, makrofaglar plazma oqsillarini butunligiça pinotsitoz qilib, aminokislotalarga parçalaydi va qonga qaytaradi. Şu tarzda plazma oqsillari labil oqsil zaxirasi vazifasini bajaradi.

**Qaytar muvozanat (70-2-rasm):** plazma oqsillari ↔ plazma aminokislotalari ↔ töqima oqsillari. Radioaktiv izlovçilar böyiça kuniga ~400 g tana oqsili sintezlanib, parçalanadi. Oçlik yoki oğir kasallikda ham töqima/plazma oqsillari nisbati ~33:1 bölib qoladi.
Şuning uçun oğir, ötkir umumiy oqsil yetişmovçiligining eng samarali davolaridan biri — plazma oqsilini vena içiga quyiş. Bir neça kun yoki soat içida uning aminokislotalari hujayralarga tarqaladi.

10 tasi tanada sintezlanadi (almaşinadigan), 10 tasi sintezlanmaydi yoki yetarli sintezlanmaydi — **almaşinmaydigan (essential)**, ovqatdan olinişi şart. “Almaşinadigan” degani ular kerak emas degani emas, faqat ratsionda şart emas.
Almaşinadigan aminokislotalar sintezi tegişli **α-keto kislotalar** hosil bölişiga boğliq. Masalan, glikolizda köp hosil böladigan piruvat — alaninning keto-kislota prekursori.

**Transaminlaniş:** amino guruh α-keto kislotaga ötadi, keto kislorod esa donorga. Masalan glutamat + piruvat → α-ketoglutarat + alanin (70-3-rasm). Amino guruh asparagin, aspartat va glutamindan ham ötişi mumkin.
**Glutamin** töqimalarda köp va amino guruhlar “ombori” vazifasini bajaradi. Reaksiyalar qaytar.
Transaminlanişni **aminotransferazalar** katalizlaydi. Ular piridoksin (vitamin B6) hosilalari; B6 bölmasa aminokislotalar yomon sintezlanadi va oqsil hosil bölişi buziladi.
Hujayralar tölgaç, ortiqça aminokislotalar energiya uçun parçalanadi yoki asosan yoğ, ikkinçi navbatda glikogen sifatida saqlanadi. Bu deyarli faqat jigarda böladi va dezaminlanişdan boşlanadi.

**Dezaminlaniş** asosan transaminlaniş orqali: aminokislota + α-ketoglutarat → α-keto kislota + glutamat. Glutamat amino guruhni boşqa moddaga beradi yoki NH3 körinişida çiqaradi (NAD+ → NADH) va yana α-ketoglutaratga aylanadi, sikl takrorlanadi. Ortiqça aminokislotalar aminotransferazalarning köp miqdorda faollaşişini qözğatadi.

**Moçevina hosil bölişi (jigar):** 2NH3 + CO2 → moçevina + H2O. Bosqiçlari: ornitin + CO2 + NH3 → sitrullin; + NH3 → arginin; arginaza ta’sirida + H2O → moçevina + ornitin. Moçevina tana suyuqliklariga diffuziya qilib, buyrak orqali çiqariladi.
Deyarli barça moçevina jigarda hosil böladi. Jigar bölmasa yoki oğir jigar kasalligida ammiak qonda töplanadi; u ayniqsa miya uçun juda zaharli va **jigar komasiga** olib kelişi mumkin.

**Dezaminlangan aminokislotalarning oksidlanişi:** keto kislota limon kislota sikliga kira oladigan moddaga aylanadi va asetil-KoA kabi energiya uçun parçalanadi. 1 g oqsildan hosil böladigan ATF 1 g glyukozadan biroz kamroq.

**Glyukoneogenez va ketogenez:** masalan, dezaminlangan alanin = piruvat; u glyukoza/glikogenga yoki asetil-KoA orqali yoğ kislotalariga aylanişi mumkin; ikki asetil-KoA asetoasetatni (keton tana) hosil qiladi. 20 dezaminlangan aminokislotadan 18 tasi glyukozaga, 19 tasi yoğ kislotalariga aylana oladi.

Oqsil yemagan odamda ham kuniga 20–30 g tana oqsili parçalanib oksidlanadi (**majburiy yöqotiş**). Şuning uçun kamida 20–30 g/kun oqsil kerak (muşak massasi, faollik, yoşga boğliq); xavfsizlik uçun odatda 60–75 g tavsiya etiladi.

Ratsion oqsilidagi aminokislotalar nisbati tana töqimalarinikiga yaqin bölişi kerak. Bitta almaşinmaydigan aminokislota kam bölsa, qolganlari ham işlatilmaydi, çunki hujayra oqsilni yo töliq sintezlaydi, yo umuman sintezlamaydi (3-bob). Işlatilmagan aminokislotalar dezaminlanib, oksidlanadi.
Nisbati boşqaça oqsil **töliq bölmagan (partial/incomplete) oqsil** deyiladi va töliq oqsildan kam qimmatli.

**Oçlik:** majburiy 20–30 g dan taşqari, uglevod va yoğ mavjud ekan, energiya deyarli faqat ulardan olinadi. Bir neça hafta oçlikdan söng zaxiralar tugay boşlaganda, aminokislotalar tez dezaminlanadi, töqima oqsillari kuniga 125 g gaça parçalanadi va hujayra funksiyalari keskin yomonlaşadi. Şuning uçun uglevod va yoğlar **oqsilni tejovçilar (protein sparers)** deyiladi.

**Ösiş gormoni:** hujayra oqsillarini oşiradi; ehtimoliy mexanizm — membranadan aminokislota transportini oşiriş, DNK/RNK transkripsiya va translyatsiyasini tezlaştiriş, töqima oqsillari oksidlanişini kamaytiriş.

**Insulin:** töliq yetişmasa oqsil sintezi deyarli nolga tuşadi. Ba’zi aminokislotalarning hujayraga kirişini tezlaştiradi, oqsil parçalanişini kamaytiradi va glyukoza mavjudligini oşirib, aminokislotalarga energiya ehtiyojini kamaytiradi.
**Glyukokortikoidlar:** köp töqimalarda (jigardan taşqari) oqsilni kamaytiradi, plazma aminokislotalarini oşiradi; bu jigarga hujayra oqsillari va plazma oqsillarini köproq sintezlaş imkonini beradi.

**Testosteron:** töqimalarda, ayniqsa muşak qisqaruvçi oqsillarida oqsil töplanişini 30–50% ga oşiradi. Ösiş gormonidan farqi: ösiş gormoni töqimalarni deyarli çeksiz östiradi, testosteron esa muşaklarni faqat bir neça oy kattalaştiradi, söng maksimumga yetib töxtaydi.
**Estrogen:** oqsil töplanişiga ança kuçsizroq ta’sir qiladi.

**Tiroksin:** bilvosita, hujayra metabolizmini oşirib ta’sir qiladi. Uglevod va yoğ yetarli bölmasa, oqsillarni tez parçalab energiya uçun işlatadi; yetarli bölsa va aminokislotalar köp bölsa, oqsil sintezini oşirişi mumkin. Ösayotgan organizmda tiroksin yetişmasa oqsil sintezi kamayib, ösiş kuçli töxtaydi. Asosan anabolik va katabolik reaksiyalarning umumiy tezligini oşiradi.
Jigar sirrozi → gipoalbuminemiya → umumiy şiş.
Oğir jigar kasalligi → ammiak töplanişi → jigar komasi.
Kuyiş va nefrotik holatlarda katta oqsil yöqotişini jigar sintezi qoplaydi.
Ötkir oğir oqsil yetişmovçiligida plazma oqsili quyiş samarali.
B6 yetişmovçiligi transaminlanişni buzadi.
Saraton töqimasi boşqa töqimalar oqsillarini kamaytirib yuborişi mumkin.

3-bob (oqsil sintezi), 4-bob (membrana transporti), 16 va 25-boblar (kolloid osmotik bosim, şiş), 35-bob (immunitet), 37-bob (iviş), 68–69-boblar (uglevod va yoğ almaşinuvi), 71-bob (jigar), 76–81-boblar (gormonlar).

full.text: About three-quarters of the body solids are proteins. These proteins include structural proteins, enzymes, nucleoproteins, proteins that transport oxygen, proteins of the muscle that cause muscle contraction, and many other types that perform specific intracellular and extra cellular functions throughout the body.

The basic chemical properties that explain the diverse functions of proteins are so extensive that they constitute a major portion of the entire discipline of biochemistry. For this reason, the current discussion is confined to a few specific aspects of protein metabolism that are important as background for other discussions in this text.

The principal constituents of proteins are amino acids. Twenty of these amino acids are present in the body pro teins in significant quantities. **Figure 70-1**, which shows the chemical formulas of these 20 amino acids, demon strates that they all have two features in common; each amino acid has an acidic group (–COOH) and a nitrogen atom attached to the molecule, usually represented by the amino group (–NH2).
The amino ac ids of proteins are aggregated into long chains by means of _peptide linkages_. The chemical nature of this linkage is demonstrated by the following reaction:
full.lead: Peptide Linkages and Peptide Chains.

full.text: Note in this reaction that the nitrogen of the amino radical of one amino acid bonds with the carbon of the carboxyl radical of the other amino acid. A hydrogen ion is released from the amino radical, and a hydroxyl ion is released from the carboxyl radical; these two ions com bine to form a molecule of water. After the peptide linkage has been formed, an amino radical and a carboxyl radical are still at opposite ends of the new, longer molecule. Each of these radicals is capable of combining with additional amino acids to form a _peptide chain_. Some complicated protein molecules have many thousands of amino acids combined by peptide linkages, and even the smallest pro tein molecule usually has more than 20 amino acids com bined by peptide linkages. The average is about 400 amino acids.

Some protein molecules are composed of several peptide chains rather than a single chain, and these chains are bound to one an other by other linkages, often by _hydrogen bonding_ between the CO and NH radicals of the peptides, as follows:
full.lead: Other Linkages in Protein Molecules.

full.text: Many peptide chains are coiled or folded, and the suc cessive coils or folds are held in a tight spiral or in other shapes by similar hydrogen bonding and other forces.

The normal concentration of amino acids in the blood is between 35 and 65 mg/dl, which is an average of about 2 mg/dl for each of the 20 amino acids, although some are present in far greater amounts than are others. Because the amino acids are relatively strong acids, they exist in the blood principally in the ionized state, as a result of the re moval of one hydrogen atom from the NH2 radical. They actually account for 2 to 3 milliequivalents of the negative ions in the blood. The precise distribution of the different amino acids in the blood depends to some extent on the types of proteins eaten, but the concentrations of at least some individual amino acids are regulated by selective syn thesis in the different cells.

The products of protein digestion and absorption in the gastrointestinal tract are almost entirely amino acids; only rarely are polypeptides or whole protein molecules ab sorbed from the digestive tract into the blood. Soon after a meal, the amino acid concentration in a person’s blood rises, but the increase is usually only a few milligrams per deciliter, for two reasons: First, protein digestion and ab sorption are usually extended over 2 to 3 hours, which al lows only small quantities of amino acids to be absorbed at a time. Second, after entering the blood, the additional amino acids are absorbed within 5 to 10 minutes by cells throughout the body, especially by the liver. Therefore, large concentrations of amino acids almost never accumulate in the blood and tissue fluids. Nevertheless, the turnover rate of the amino acids is so rapid that many grams of proteins can be carried from one part of the body to another in the form of amino acids each hour.
full.lead: Fate of Amino Acids Absorbed From the Gastrointestinal Tract.

full.text: The molecules of all the amino acids are much too large to diffuse readily through the pores of the cell membranes. Therefore, significant quantities of amino acids can move either inward or outward through the membranes only by facilitated transport or active transport using carrier mech anisms. The nature of some of the carrier mechanisms is not completely understood, but a few are discussed in Chapter 4.
full.lead: Active Transport of Amino Acids Into the Cells.

full.text: In the kidneys, the different amino acids that are filtered by the glomerular capillaries can be reabsorbed through the proximal tubu lar epithelium by _secondary active transport_, which returns them to the blood. However, as is true of other active trans port mechanisms in the renal tubules, there is an upper limit to the rate at which each type of amino acid can be transported. For this reason, when the concentration of a particular type of amino acid becomes too high in the plasma and glomerular filtrate, the excess that cannot be actively reabsorbed is lost into the urine.
full.lead: Renal Threshold for Amino Acids.

full.text: After entry into tissue cells, amino acids combine with one another by peptide linkages, under the direction of the cell’s messenger RNA and ribosomal system, to form cellular proteins. Therefore, the concentration of free amino acids inside most cells usually remains low, and storage of large quantities of free amino acids does not occur in the cells; instead, they are stored mainly in the form of actual pro teins. However, many of these intracellular proteins can be rapidly decomposed again into amino acids under the in fluence of intracellular lysosomal digestive enzymes. These amino acids can then be transported back out of the cell into the blood. Special exceptions to this reversal process are the proteins in the chromosomes of the nucleus and the structural proteins such as collagen and muscle contractile proteins. These proteins do not participate significantly in this reverse digestion and transport back out of the cells.

Some tissues of the body participate in the storage of amino acids to a greater extent than do others. For exam ple, the liver, which is a large organ and has special sys tems for processing amino acids, can store large quantities of rapidly exchangeable proteins, which is also true of the kidneys and the intestinal mucosa to a lesser extent.

Whenever plasma amino acid concentrations fall below normal levels, the re quired amino acids are transported out of the cells to re plenish their supply in the plasma. In this way, the plasma concentration of each type of amino acid is maintained at a reasonably constant value. Some of the hormones secreted by the endocrine glands are able to alter the balance between tissue proteins and circulating amino acids. For example, growth hormone and insulin increase the formation of tis sue proteins, whereas adrenocortical glucocorticoid hor mones increase the concentration of plasma amino acids.
full.lead: Amino Acid Release From Cells as a Means of Regulating Plasma Amino Acid Concentration.

full.text: Because cellular proteins in the liver (and, to a much less extent, in other tissues) can be synthe sized rapidly from plasma amino acids, and because many of these proteins can be degraded and returned to the plas ma almost as rapidly, constant interchange and equilibrium occurs between the plasma amino acids and labile proteins in virtually all cells of the body. For example, if a particu lar tissue requires proteins, it can synthesize new proteins from amino acids of the blood; in turn, blood amino acids are replenished by degradation of proteins from other cells of the body, especially from liver cells. These effects are particularly noticeable in relation to protein synthesis in cancer cells. Cancer cells are often prolific users of amino acids; therefore, the proteins of the other cells can become markedly depleted.
full.lead: Reversible Equilibrium Between the Proteins in Different Parts of the Body.

full.text: Each type of cell has an upper limit with regard to the amount of proteins it can store. After all the cells have reached their limits, the excess amino acids still in the circulation are degraded into other products and used for energy, as discussed subse quently, or they are converted to fat or glycogen and stored in these forms.
full.lead: Upper Limit for the Storage of Proteins.

full.text: The major types of protein present in the plasma are _albu min, globulin_, and _fibrinogen_.
A major function of _albumin_ is to provide _colloid os motic pressure_ in the plasma, which prevents plasma loss from the capillaries, as discussed in Chapter 16.

The _globulins_ perform several _enzymatic functions_ in the plasma, but equally important, they are principally respon sible for both the natural and acquired _immunity_ of the body against invading organisms, as discussed in Chapter 35.
_Fibrinogen_ polymerizes into long fibrin threads during blood coagulation, thereby _forming blood clots_ that help repair leaks in the circulatory system, as discussed in Chapter 37.

Essentially all the albumin and fibrinogen of the plasma proteins, as well as 50% to 80% of the globulins, are formed in the liver. The remaining globulins, which are formed almost entirely in lymphoid tissues, are mainly gamma globulins that consti tute antibodies used in the immune system.
full.lead: Formation of the Plasma Proteins.

full.text: The rate of plasma protein formation by the liver can be extremely high—as much as 30 g/day. Certain disease conditions cause rapid loss of plasma proteins; for example, severe burns that denude large surface areas of the skin can cause the loss of several liters of plasma through the denud ed areas each day. The rapid production of plasma proteins by the liver is valuable in preventing death in such states. Occasionally, a person with severe renal disease loses as much as 20 grams of plasma protein in the urine each day for months, and this plasma protein is continually replaced mainly by liver production of the required proteins.

In persons with _cirrhosis of the liver_, large numbers of liver cells are destroyed and replaced by fibrous tis sue, causing a reduction in the liver’s ability to synthesize plasma proteins. As discussed in Chapter 25, liver cirrhosis leads to decreased plasma colloid osmotic pressure, which causes generalized edema.

When the tissues become depleted of proteins, the plasma proteins can act as a source of rapid replacement. Indeed, whole plasma proteins can be imbibed in toto by tissue macrophages through the process of pinocytosis; once in these cells, they are split into amino acids that are transported back into the blood and used throughout the body to build cellular proteins wherever they are needed. In this way, the plasma proteins function as a labile protein storage medium and represent a readily available source of amino acids whenever a particular tissue requires them.
full.lead: Plasma Proteins as a Source of Amino Acids for the Tissues.

full.text: As shown in **Figure 70-2**, a con stant state of equilibrium exists among the plasma proteins, the amino acids of the plasma, and the tissue proteins. On the basis of radioactive tracer studies, it has been estimated that normally about 400 grams of body protein are synthe sized and degraded each day as part of the continual state of flux of amino acids, which demonstrates the general princi ple of reversible exchange of amino acids among the differ ent proteins of the body. Even during starvation or severe debilitating diseases, the ratio of total tissue proteins to to tal plasma proteins in the body remains relatively constant at about 33:1.
full.lead: Reversible Equilibrium Between the Plasma Proteins and the Tissue Proteins.

full.text: Because of this reversible equilibrium between plasma proteins and the other proteins of the body, one of the most effective therapies for severe, acute whole-body protein de ficiency is intravenous transfusion of plasma protein. With in a few days, or sometimes within hours, the amino acids of administered protein are distributed throughout the cells of the body to form new proteins as needed.

Ten of the amino acids normally present in animal proteins can be synthesized in the cells, whereas the other 10 either cannot be synthesized or are synthesized in quantities too small to supply the body’s needs. This second group of amino ac ids that cannot be synthesized is called the _essential amino acids_. Use of the word “essential” does not mean that the other 10 “nonessential” amino acids are not required for the formation of proteins but only that the others are _not essen tial in the diet_ because they can be synthesized in the body.
full.lead: Essential and Nonessential Amino Acids.

full.text: Synthesis of the nonessential amino acids depends mainly on the formation of appropriate α-keto acids, which are the precursors of the respective amino acids. For ex ample, _pyruvic acid_, which is formed in large quantities during the glycolytic breakdown of glucose, is the keto acid precursor of the amino acid _alanine_. Then, by the process of _transamination_, an amino radical is transferred to the α-keto acid, and the keto oxygen is transferred to the do nor of the amino radical. This reaction is shown in **Figure 70-3**. Note that alanine is formed after the amino radical is transferred to the pyruvic acid from glutamic acid. Amino radicals can be transferred from _asparagine, aspartic acid,_ and _glutamine_. Glutamine is present in the tissues in large quantities, and one of its principal functions is to serve as an amino radical storehouse.
Note also that the reactions are reversible so that trans fer of amino groups can also occur during degradation of amino acids, as discussed later.

Transamination is promoted by several enzymes, among which are the _aminotransferases_, which are deriva tives of pyridoxine, one of the B vitamins (B6). Without this vitamin, the amino acids are poorly synthesized, and pro tein formation cannot proceed normally.

Once the cells are filled to their limits with stored protein, any additional amino acids in the body fluids are degraded and used for energy or are stored mainly as fat or second arily as glycogen. This degradation occurs almost entirely in the liver, and it begins with _deamination_, which is ex plained in the following section.

Deamination occurs mainly by _transamination_, which means transfer of the amino group to some accep tor substance. This process is the reverse of the process for synthesis of amino acids, which was previously explained.
full.lead: Deamination—Removal of Amino Groups From Amino Acids.

full.text: The greatest amount of deamination occurs according to the following transamination schema:

Note from this illustration that the amino group from the amino acid is transferred to α-ketoglutaric acid, which then becomes glutamic acid. The glutamic acid can then transfer the amino group to other substances or release it in the form of ammonia (NH3). In the process of losing the amino group, the glutamic acid once again becomes α-ketoglutaric acid, so the cycle can be repeated again and again. To initiate this process, the excess amino acids in the cells, especially in the liver, induce activation of large quan tities of _aminotransferases_, the enzymes responsible for ini tiating most deamination.

The ammonia released during deamination of amino acids is removed from the blood almost entirely by conversion into urea. Two mol ecules of ammonia (NH3) and one molecule of carbon di oxide (CO2) combine in the following net reaction:
full.lead: Urea Formation by the Liver.

full.text: Essentially all urea formed in the human body is synthe sized in the liver. In the absence of the liver or in persons with serious liver disease, ammonia accumulates in the blood. This accumulation of ammonia is extremely toxic, especially to the brain, and can lead to a state called _hepatic coma_.
The stages in the formation of urea are essentially the following:
After its formation, the urea diffuses from the liver cells into the body fluids and is excreted by the kidneys.

Once amino acids have been deaminated, the resulting keto acids can, in most cases, be oxidized to release energy for metabolic purposes. This oxidation usually involves two successive processes: 1. The keto acid is changed into an appropriate chemi cal substance that can enter the citric acid cycle. 2. This substance is degraded by the cycle and used for energy in the same manner that acetyl coenzyme A (acetyl-CoA) derived from carbohydrate and lipid me tabolism is used, as explained in Chapters 68 and 69. In general, the amount of adenosine triphosphate formed for each gram of protein that is oxidized is slightly less than that formed for each gram of glucose that is oxi dized.
full.lead: Oxidation of Deaminated Amino Acids.

full.text: Certain deaminat ed amino acids are similar to the substrates normally used by the cells, mainly the liver cells, to synthesize glucose or fatty acids. For example, deaminated alanine is pyruvic acid, which can be converted into either glucose or gly cogen. Alternatively, it can be converted into acetyl-CoA, which can then be polymerized into fatty acids. Also, two molecules of acetyl-CoA can condense to form acetoacetic acid, which is one of the ketone bodies, as explained in Chapter 69.
full.lead: Gluconeogenesis and Ketogenesis.

full.text: The conversion of amino acids into glucose or glycogen is called _gluconeogenesis_, and the conversion of amino acids into keto acids or fatty acids is called _ketogenesis_. Of the 20 deaminated amino acids, 18 have chemical structures that allow them to be converted into glucose, and 19 of them can be converted into fatty acids.

When a person eats no proteins, a certain proportion of body proteins is degraded into amino acids and then deaminated and oxidized. This process involves 20 to 30 grams of protein each day, which is called the _obligatory loss of proteins._ There fore, to prevent net loss of protein from the body, the average person must ingest a minimum of 20 to 30 grams of protein each day, although this amount depends on multiple factors, including muscle mass, activity, and age; to be on the safe side, a minimum of 60 to 75 grams is usually recommended.

The ratios of the different amino acids in the dietary protein must be about the same as the ratios in the body tissues if the entire dietary protein is to be fully usable to form new tissue proteins. If one particular type of essen tial amino acid is low in concentration, the others become unusable because cells synthesize either whole proteins or none at all, as explained in Chapter 3 in relation to protein synthesis. The unusable amino acids are deaminated and oxidized. A protein that has a ratio of amino acids differ ent from that of the average body protein is called a _partial protein_ or an _incomplete protein_, and such a protein is less valuable for nutrition than is a _complete protein_.

Except for the 20 to 30 grams of obligatory protein degradation each day, the body uses almost entirely carbohydrates or fats for energy, as long as they are available. However, after several weeks of starvation, when the quantities of stored carbo hydrates and fats begin to run out, the amino acids of the blood are rapidly deaminated and oxidized for energy. From this point on, the proteins of the tissues degrade rapidly—as much as 125 grams daily—and, as a result, cellular functions deteriorate precipitously. Because carbohydrate and fat uti lization for energy normally occurs in preference to protein utilization, carbohydrates and fats are called _protein sparers_.
full.lead: Effect of Starvation on Protein Degradation.

full.text: Growth hormone causes the tissue proteins to increase. The precise mechanism by which this increase occurs is not fully understood, but it is believed to result mainly from increased transport of amino acids through the cell membranes, acceleration of the DNA and RNA transcription and translation processes for protein synthe sis, and decreased oxidation of tissue proteins.
full.lead: Growth Hormone Increases the Synthesis of Cellular Proteins.

full.text: Total lack of insulin reduces protein synthesis to almost zero. Insulin ac celerates transport of some amino acids into cells, which could be the stimulus for protein synthesis. Also, insulin re duces protein degradation and increases the availability of glucose to the cells, so the need for amino acids for energy is correspondingly reduced.
full.lead: Insulin Is Necessary for Protein Synthesis.

full.text: Glucocorticoids secreted by the adrenal cor tex _decrease_ the quantity of protein in _most_ tissues while increasing amino acid concentration in the plasma, as well as increasing _liver proteins and plasma proteins._ Gluco corticoids increase the rate of breakdown of extrahepatic proteins, thereby making increased quantities of amino acids available in the body fluids. This allows the liver to synthesize increased quantities of hepatic cellular proteins and plasma proteins.
full.lead: Glucocorticoids Increase Breakdown of Most Tissue Proteins.

full.text: Testosterone, the male sex hormone, causes in creased deposition of protein in tissues throughout the body, especially the contractile proteins of the muscles (a 30%−50% increase). The mechanism of this effect is unknown, but it is definitely different from the effect of growth hormone, in the following way: Growth hormone causes tissues to continue growing almost indefinitely, whereas testosterone causes the muscles and, to a much lesser extent, some other protein tissues to enlarge for only several months. Once the muscles and other pro tein tissues have reached a maximum, despite continued administration of testosterone, further protein deposi tion ceases.
full.lead: Testosterone Increases Protein Deposition in Tissues.

full.text: Estrogen, the principal female sex hormone, also causes some deposition of protein, but the effect of estrogen is much less compared with that of testosterone.
full.lead: Estrogen.

full.text: Thyroxine in directly affects protein metabolism by increasing metabo lism of the cells. If insufficient carbohydrates and fats are available for energy, thyroxine causes rapid degradation of proteins and uses them for energy. Conversely, if adequate quantities of carbohydrates and fats are available and excess amino acids are also available in the extracellular fluid, thy roxine can actually increase the rate of protein synthesis. In growing animals or human beings, deficiency of thyroxine causes growth to be greatly inhibited because of lack of pro tein synthesis. In essence, it is believed that thyroxine has little specific effect on protein metabolism but does have an important general effect by increasing the rates of both normal anabolic and normal catabolic protein reactions.
full.lead: Thyroxine Increases Metabolism of Cells.

glossary.contextUz: Peptid boği: bir aminokislotaning amino azoti boşqasining karboksil uglerodi bilan boğlanadi, H+ va OH− suv hosil qiladi.
Qondagi aminokislotalar: 35–65 mg/dl (har biriga örtaça ~2 mg/dl).
Hujayraga kiriş: molekulalar teşiklardan diffuziya qiliş uçun juda katta, şuning uçun faqat taşuvçilar orqali yengillaşgan yoki faol transport bilan ötadi.
Buyrak ostonasi: glomerulda filtrlangan aminokislotalar proksimal kanalçada ikkilamçi faol transport bilan qayta söriladi.
Hujayrada saqlaş: aminokislotalar mRNK va ribosomalar boşqaruvida darhol oqsilga aylanadi, şuning uçun erkin aminokislota konsentratsiyasi past.
Plazma darajasini boşqariş: plazmadagi aminokislota kamaysa, hujayralardan çiqariladi, şu bilan har bir turning plazma konsentratsiyasi barqaror turadi.
Yuqori çegara: har bir hujayra turi ma’lum miqdordan ortiq oqsil saqlay olmaydi.
Asosiy turlari: albumin, globulin, fibrinogen.
Hosil bölişi: deyarli barça albumin va fibrinogen hamda globulinlarning 50–80% jigarda.
Jigar sirrozi: jigar hujayralari fibroz töqimaga almaşadi → plazma oqsillari sintezi kamayadi → kolloid osmotik bosim pasayadi → umumiy şiş (25-bob).
Aminokislota manbai sifatida: töqimalar oqsilga muhtoj bölsa, makrofaglar plazma oqsillarini butunligiça pinotsitoz qilib, aminokislotalarga parçalaydi va qonga qaytaradi.
Qaytar muvozanat (70-2-rasm): plazma oqsillari ↔ plazma aminokislotalari ↔ töqima oqsillari.
10 tasi tanada sintezlanadi (almaşinadigan), 10 tasi sintezlanmaydi yoki yetarli sintezlanmaydi — almaşinmaydigan (essential), ovqatdan olinişi şart.
Almaşinadigan aminokislotalar sintezi tegişli α-keto kislotalar hosil bölişiga boğliq.
Transaminlaniş: amino guruh α-keto kislotaga ötadi, keto kislorod esa donorga.
Glutamin töqimalarda köp va amino guruhlar “ombori” vazifasini bajaradi.
Transaminlanişni aminotransferazalar katalizlaydi.
Dezaminlaniş asosan transaminlaniş orqali: aminokislota + α-ketoglutarat → α-keto kislota + glutamat.
Moçevina hosil bölişi (jigar): 2NH3 + CO2 → moçevina + H2O.
Jigar bölmasa yoki oğir jigar kasalligida ammiak qonda töplanadi; u ayniqsa miya uçun juda zaharli va jigar komasiga olib kelişi mumkin.
Dezaminlangan aminokislotalarning oksidlanişi: keto kislota limon kislota sikliga kira oladigan moddaga aylanadi va asetil-KoA kabi energiya uçun parçalanadi.

Glyukoneogenez va ketogenez: masalan, dezaminlangan alanin = piruvat; u glyukoza/glikogenga yoki asetil-KoA orqali yoğ kislotalariga aylanişi mumkin; ikki asetil-KoA asetoasetatni (keton tana) hosil qiladi.
Oqsil yemagan odamda ham kuniga 20–30 g tana oqsili parçalanib oksidlanadi (majburiy yöqotiş).
Nisbati boşqaça oqsil töliq bölmagan (partial/incomplete) oqsil deyiladi va töliq oqsildan kam qimmatli.
Oçlik: majburiy 20–30 g dan taşqari, uglevod va yoğ mavjud ekan, energiya deyarli faqat ulardan olinadi.
Şuning uçun uglevod va yoğlar oqsilni tejovçilar (protein sparers) deyiladi.

Ösiş gormoni: hujayra oqsillarini oşiradi; ehtimoliy mexanizm — membranadan aminokislota transportini oşiriş, DNK/RNK transkripsiya va translyatsiyasini tezlaştiriş, töqima oqsillari oksidlanişini kamaytiriş.
Insulin: töliq yetişmasa oqsil sintezi deyarli nolga tuşadi.
Glyukokortikoidlar: köp töqimalarda (jigardan taşqari) oqsilni kamaytiradi, plazma aminokislotalarini oşiradi; bu jigarga hujayra oqsillari va plazma oqsillarini köproq sintezlaş imkonini beradi.
Testosteron: töqimalarda, ayniqsa muşak qisqaruvçi oqsillarida oqsil töplanişini 30–50% ga oşiradi.
Estrogen: oqsil töplanişiga ança kuçsizroq ta’sir qiladi.
Tiroksin: bilvosita, hujayra metabolizmini oşirib ta’sir qiladi.

The conversion of amino acids into glucose or glycogen is called gluconeogenesis, and the conversion of amino acids into keto acids or fatty acids is called ketogenesis

keyNumbers.text: A hydrogen ion Blood Amino Acids The normal concentration of amino acids in the blood is between 35 and 65 mg/dl, which is an average of about 2 mg/dl for each of the 20 amino acids, although some are present in far greater amounts than are others

Soon after a meal, the amino acid concentration in a person’s blood rises, but the increase is usually only a few milligrams per deciliter, for two reasons: First, protein digestion and absorption are usually extended over 2 to 3 hours, which allows only small quantities of amino acids to be absorbed at a time
Second, after entering the blood, the additional 866 amino acids are absorbed within 5 to 10 minutes by cells throughout the body, especially by the liver
Essentially all the albumin and fibrinogen of the plasma proteins, as well as 50% to 80% of the globulins, are formed in the liver
The rate of plasma protein formation by the liver can be extremely high—as much as 30 g/day

Occasionally, a person with severe renal disease loses as much as 20 grams of plasma protein in the urine each day for months, and this plasma protein is continually replaced mainly by liver production of the required proteins

On the basis of radioactive tracer studies, it has been estimated that normally about 400 grams of body protein are synthesized and degraded each day as part of the continual state of flux of amino acids, which demonstrates the general principle of reversible exchange of amino acids among the different proteins of the body
This process involves 20 to 30 grams of protein each day, which is called the obligatory loss of proteins

Except for the 20 to 30 grams of obligatory protein degradation each day, the body uses almost entirely carbohydrates or fats for energy, as long as they are available
From this point on, the proteins of the tissues degrade rapidly—as much as 125 grams daily—and, as a result, cellular functions deteriorate precipitously

ch70-f0.text: Tana quruq massasining taxminan törtdan uç qismini oqsillar taşkil qiladi. Ularga tuzilma oqsillari, fermentlar, nukleoproteinlar, kislorod taşuvçi oqsillar, muşak qisqarişini ta’minlovçi oqsillar va organizmda hujayra içida hamda taşqarisida maxsus vazifalarni bajaruvçi boşqa oqsillar kiradi.

ch70-f1.text: Oqsillarning turli vazifalarini tuşuntiradigan kimyoviy xususiyatlar biokimyoning katta qismini taşkil qiladi. Bu bobda oqsil almaşinuvining darslikdagi boşqa mavzularni tuşuniş uçun zarur ayrim jihatlari körib çiqiladi.

ch70-f2.text: Oqsillarning asosiy tarkibiy qismlari aminokislotalardir. Tana oqsillarida ulardan yigirmatasi sezilarli miqdorda uçraydi. **Rasm 70-1** da ularning formulalari berilgan. Har birida kislotali guruh (–COOH) va molekulaga birikkan azot atomi mavjud. Azot odatda aminoguruh (–NH₂) tarkibiga kiradi.

ch70-f4.text: Oqsildagi aminokislotalar _peptid boğlari_ orqali uzun zanjirlarga birikadi. Ikki aminokislota birikayotganda suv ajraladi va ular orasida –CO–NH– boği hosil böladi.

ch70-f5.text: Bir aminokislotaning aminoguruhidagi azot ikkinçisining karboksil guruhidagi uglerodga birikadi. Aminoguruhdan vodorod, karboksil guruhidan gidroksil ajralib, bir molekula suv hosil qiladi. Yangi, uzunroq molekulaning qarama-qarşi uçlarida aminoguruh va karboksil guruh saqlanadi. Har biri yana aminokislota bilan birikib, _peptid zanjiri_ hosil qila oladi. Ayrim murakkab oqsillarda minglab aminokislota peptid boğlari bilan birikadi. Eng kiçik oqsil molekulalari ham odatda yigirmadan ortiq aminokislotadan, örtaçasi esa taxminan 400 aminokislotadan iborat.

ch70-f6.text: Ayrim oqsillar bir neçta peptid zanjiridan tuzilgan. Bu zanjirlarni boşqa turdagi boğlar, köpinça peptidlarning CO va NH guruhlari orasidagi _vodorod boğlari_ birlaştiradi.

ch70-f7.text: Köp peptid zanjirlari öralgan yoki buklangan. Ularning ketma-ket buramalari yoki buklamalarini şunga öxşaş vodorod boğlari va boşqa kuçlar ziç spiral yoki boşqa şakllarda uşlab turadi.

ch70-f8.text: Qondagi aminokislotalarning odatiy umumiy konsentratsiyasi 35–65 mg/dl. Bu yigirmata aminokislotaning har biriga örtaça taxminan 2 mg/dl töğri kelişini anglatadi, lekin ayrimlari boşqalaridan ança köp. Aminokislotalar qonda asosan ionlangan şaklda uçraydi. Darslik hisobida ular qonning manfiy ionlariga 2–3 milliekvivalent hissa qöşadi. Qondagi aminokislotalarning nisbati qisman ovqatdagi oqsil turlariga boğliq. Ayrim aminokislotalarning konsentratsiyasi turli hujayralardagi tanlab sintez qiliş orqali ham boşqariladi.

ch70-f9.text: Hazm yölida oqsillarning hazm bölişi va sörilişining yakuniy mahsulotlari deyarli butunlay aminokislotalardir. Polipeptidlar yoki butun oqsil molekulalari qonga kamdan-kam ötadi. Ovqatdan köp ötmay qondagi aminokislotalar konsentratsiyasi odatda atigi bir neça mg/dl kötariladi. Birinçidan, oqsil hazmi va sörilişi odatda 2–3 soat davom etadi, şu sababli bir vaqtda oz miqdor söriladi. Ikkinçidan, qöşimça aminokislotalar qonga tuşgaç 5–10 daqiqada tana hujayralariga, ayniqsa jigarga ötadi. Şuning uçun qon va töqima suyuqligida aminokislotalar yuqori konsentratsiyada deyarli töplanmaydi. Ammo almaşinuv şu qadar tezki, har soatda oqsilning köp grammiga teng aminokislotalar tananing bir joyidan boşqasiga taşilişi mumkin.
ch70-f9.lead: Hazm yölidan sörilgan aminokislotalarning keyingi taqdiri.

ch70-f10.text: Aminokislota molekulalari hujayra membranasi teşiklaridan oson diffuziyalana olmaydigan darajada yirik. Şuning uçun sezilarli miqdor membranadan içkariga yoki taşqariga taşuvçi vositasidagi yengillaşgan yoki faol transport orqali ötadi. Ayrim taşuvçilarning işlaşi töliq aniqlanmagan. Ularning bir qismi 4-bobda muhokama qilinadi.

ch70-f11.text: Buyrak koptokçalarida filtrlangan aminokislotalar proksimal kanalça epiteliysidan _ikkilamçi faol transport_ bilan qayta sörilib, qonga qaytişi mumkin. Kanalçalardagi boşqa faol taşuvçilarda bölgani kabi, har bir aminokislotani taşiş tezligining yuqori çegarasi bor. Muayyan aminokislota plazma va koptokça filtratida ortiqça köpaysa, qayta sörilişga ulgurmagan qismi siydik bilan yöqotiladi.

ch70-f12.text: Aminokislotalar töqima hujayralariga kirgaç axborot RNKsi va ribosomalar yordamida peptid boğlari orqali birikib, hujayra oqsillarini hosil qiladi. Şu sababli köpçilik hujayralarda erkin aminokislotalar konsentratsiyasi past. Aminokislotalar asosan oqsil şaklida zaxiralanadi. Köp hujayra oqsillari lizosoma fermentlari ta’sirida tez qayta aminokislotalarga parçalanadi. Aminokislotalar hujayradan çiqib qonga qaytişi mumkin. Yadro xromosomalaridagi oqsillar, kollagen va muşak qisqaruvçi oqsillari kabi tuzilma oqsillari bu teskari parçalaniş va hujayradan taşilişga kam qöşiladi.

ch70-f13.text: Ayrim töqimalar aminokislotalarni boşqalariga qaraganda köproq zaxiralaydi. Masalan, jigar katta a’zo bölib, aminokislotalarni qayta işlaşga mos maxsus tizimlarga ega. U tez almaşinadigan oqsillarning katta miqdorini saqlaydi. Buyraklar va içak şilliq qavati ham bu vazifani nisbatan kamroq darajada bajaradi.

ch70-f14.text: Plazmadagi aminokislotalar konsentratsiyasi me’yordan tuşganda kerakli aminokislotalar zaxirani töldiriş uçun hujayradan plazmaga taşiladi. Şu tariqa har bir aminokislotaning plazmadagi konsentratsiyasi nisbatan barqaror turadi. Ayrim gormonlar töqima oqsillari va qonda aylanayotgan aminokislotalar örtasidagi muvozanatni özgartiradi. Masalan, ösiş gormoni va insulin töqima oqsillari hosil bölişini, buyrak usti pöstloği glukokortikoidlari esa plazmadagi aminokislotalar konsentratsiyasini oşiradi.
ch70-f14.lead: Aminokislotalarning hujayradan çiqişi plazmadagi miqdorni boşqaradi.

ch70-f15.text: Jigarda va ança kam darajada boşqa töqimalarda hujayra oqsillari plazma aminokislotalaridan tez sintezlanadi. Köp oqsillar parçalanib, aminokislotalar şaklida qariyb şu tezlikda plazmaga qaytişi ham mumkin. Natijada plazma aminokislotalari va deyarli barça hujayralardagi tez almaşinadigan oqsillar orasida doimiy almaşinuv va muvozanat saqlanadi. Bir töqima oqsilga muhtoj bölsa, qondagi aminokislotalardan yangi oqsil sintezlaydi. Qondagi aminokislotalar esa boşqa hujayralarda, ayniqsa jigarda, oqsillar parçalanişi hisobiga töldiriladi. Bu saraton hujayralarida yaqqol kuzatilişi mumkin. Ular köp aminokislota işlatişi tufayli boşqa hujayralarning oqsil zaxirasi ança kamayişi mumkin.
ch70-f15.lead: Tananing turli qismlaridagi oqsillar örtasidagi qaytar muvozanat.

ch70-f16.text: Har bir hujayra turi çeklangan miqdorda oqsil saqlay oladi. Hujayralardagi zaxira çegarasiga yetgaç, qondagi ortiqça aminokislotalar boşqa mahsulotlarga parçalanib energiya olişga sarflanadi yoki yoğ va glikogenga aylantirilib saqlanadi.

ch70-f18.text: _Albumin_ plazmaning _kolloid-osmotik bosimini_ ta’minlaydi. Bu bosim suyuqlikning kapillyarlardan ortiqça çiqişiga yöl qöymaydi (16-bob).

ch70-f19.text: _Globulinlar_ plazmada bir neça _fermentativ vazifani_ bajaradi. Ular organizmga kirgan mikroorganizmlarga qarşi tabiiy va orttirilgan _immunitetda_ ham muhim (35-bob).

ch70-f20.text: Qon ivişida _fibrinogen_ uzun fibrin iplariga polimerlanadi. Iplar _qon laxtasini hosil qilib_, qon tomirining şikastlangan joyidan qon oqişini töxtatişga yordam beradi (37-bob).

ch70-f21.text: Plazma albumini va fibrinogenining deyarli hammasi hamda globulinlarning 50–80 foizi jigarda hosil böladi. Qolgan globulinlar deyarli butunlay limfoid töqimalarda hosil böladigan gamma-globulinlardir. Ular immun tizimining antitanalarini taşkil qiladi.

ch70-f22.text: Jigar bir sutkada 30 g gaça plazma oqsili sintezlay oladi. Ayrim kasalliklarda plazma oqsili tez yöqotiladi. Masalan, terining katta yuzalarini oçib yuborgan oğir kuyişda şu joylar orqali sutkasiga bir neça litr plazma çiqişi mumkin. Jigarning tez oqsil işlab çiqarişi bunday holatda hayotni saqlaşga yordam beradi. Oğir buyrak kasalligida ba’zan oylar davomida siydik bilan har kuni 20 g gaça plazma oqsili yöqoladi. Uning örni asosan jigarda kerakli oqsillar uzluksiz sintezlanişi hisobiga töldiriladi.

ch70-f23.text: _Jigar sirrozida_ köp jigar hujayralari nobud böladi va ularning örnini fibroz töqima egallaydi. Natijada jigarning plazma oqsillari sintezlaş qobiliyati kamayadi. 25-bobda bayon qilinganidek, plazma kolloid-osmotik bosimining pasayişi umumiy şişga olib keladi.

ch70-f24.text: Töqimada oqsil kamayganda plazma oqsillari uning örnini tez töldirişga xizmat qiladi. Töqima makrofaglari butun plazma oqsillarini pinotsitoz orqali qabul qilib, aminokislotalargaça parçalaydi. Aminokislotalar qonga qaytariladi va hujayra oqsili kerak bölgan joylarga yetkaziladi. Demak, plazma oqsillari tez almaşinadigan zaxira va töqimalar uçun foydalanişga tayyor aminokislota manbaidir.
ch70-f24.lead: Plazma oqsillari töqimalar uçun aminokislota manbai sifatida.

ch70-f25.text: Plazma oqsillari, plazma aminokislotalari va töqima oqsillari doimiy muvozanatda (**Rasm 70-2**). Radioaktiv belgi yordamidagi tadqiqotlarga köra, aminokislotalarning uzluksiz almaşinuvida har kuni taxminan 400 g tana oqsili sintezlanadi va parçalanadi. Bu turli oqsillar örtasida aminokislotalarning qaytar almaşinuvini körsatadi. Hatto oçlik yoki oğir, holdan toydiruvçi kasallikda ham jami töqima oqsillarining jami plazma oqsillariga nisbati taxminan 33:1 darajasida saqlanadi.
ch70-f25.lead: Plazma va töqima oqsillari örtasidagi qaytar muvozanat.

ch70-f27.text: Plazma va boşqa tana oqsillari örtasidagi qaytar muvozanatga boğliq holda darslik oğir, ötkir umumiy oqsil yetişmovçiligida plazma oqsilini vena içiga yuborişni muhokama qiladi. Bir neça kun, ba’zan bir neça soat içida yuborilgan oqsillarning aminokislotalari organizm hujayralariga tarqaladi va zarur joylarda yangi oqsil sintezida qatnaşadi.

ch70-f28.text: Darslik tasnifida hayvon oqsillaridagi aminokislotalarning öntasi hujayralarda sintezlanadi. Qolgan öntasi sintezlanmaydi yoki ehtiyojni qondiriş uçun yetarli miqdorda sintezlanmaydi. Ular _almaşinmaydigan aminokislotalar_ deb ataladi va ovqatdan olinişi kerak. Almaşinadigan aminokislotalar ham oqsil sintezi uçun kerak, ammo organizm ularni özi hosil qila oladi.

ch70-f29.text: Almaşinadigan aminokislotalarning sintezi asosan ularga mos boşlanğiç birikmalar — α-ketokislotalar hosil bölişiga boğliq. Masalan, glikolizda köp hosil böladigan _pirouzum kislotasi_ _alaninning_ ketokislota boşlanğiç moddasidir. _Transaminlanişda_ aminoguruh α-ketokislotaga ötadi, donor esa mos ketokislotaga aylanadi. **Rasm 70-3** da glutamatdan piruvatga aminoguruh ötib alanin hosil bölişi körsatilgan. Aminoguruhlar _asparagin, aspartat_ va _glutamindan_ ham uzatilişi mumkin. Töqimalarda köp böladigan glutaminning asosiy vazifalaridan biri aminoazot zaxirasi bölib xizmat qilişdir.

ch70-f31.text: Bu reaksiyalar qaytar. Şu sababli aminoguruhlar aminokislotalar parçalanayotganda ham köçirilişi mumkin.

ch70-f32.text: Transaminlanişni bir neça ferment, jumladan _aminotransferazalar_ katalizlaydi. Ular B₆ vitamini — piridoksin hosilasidan koferment sifatida foydalanadi. Bu vitamin yetişmasa, aminokislota sintezi susayadi va oqsil odatdagidek hosil böla olmaydi.

ch70-f33.text: Hujayra oqsil zaxirasi tölgaç, tana suyuqligidagi ortiqça aminokislotalar energiya oliş uçun parçalanadi yoki asosan yoğ, kamroq darajada glikogen şaklida saqlanadi. Parçalanişning asosiy qismi jigarda keçadi va _dezaminlanişdan_ boşlanadi.

ch70-f34.text: Dezaminlanişning asosiy qismi _transaminlanişdan_, ya’ni aminoguruhni qabul qiluvçi boşqa moddaga köçirişdan boşlanadi. Bu oldin bayon qilingan aminokislota sinteziga teskari jarayondir.

ch70-f35.text: Asosiy transaminlaniş sxemasi: aminokislota + α-ketoglutarat ⇌ mos α-ketokislota + glutamat.

ch70-f36.text: Aminoguruh α-ketoglutaratga ötib, glutamat hosil qiladi. Glutamat aminoguruhni boşqa moddaga uzatişi yoki ammiak (NH₃) şaklida ajratişi mumkin. Aminoguruh ajralgaç, glutamat yana α-ketoglutaratga aylanadi va sikl takrorlanadi. Hujayrada, ayniqsa jigarda, aminokislotalar ortişi dezaminlanişning dastlabki bosqiçlarini bajaruvçi _aminotransferazalarni_ faollaştiradi.

ch70-f37.text: Aminokislotalardan ajralgan ammiakning deyarli hammasi moçevinaga aylantirilib, qondan çiqariladi. Umumiy hisobda ikki NH₃ va bir CO₂ molekulasidan moçevina hamda suv hosil böladi: 2NH₃ + CO₂ → CO(NH₂)₂ + H₂O.

ch70-f38.text: Odam tanasidagi moçevinaning deyarli hammasi jigarda sintezlanadi. Jigar işlamasa yoki oğir zararlansa, ammiak qonda töplanadi. Ortiqça ammiak, ayniqsa miya uçun, juda zaharli va _jigar komasiga_ olib kelişi mumkin.

ch70-f39.text: Moçevina siklida azot avval karbamoilfosfat şaklida ornitin bilan birikib sitrullin hosil qiladi. Sitrullin aspartatdan ikkinçi azotni qabul qilib, argininosuksinat orqali argininga aylanadi. Arginindan moçevina ajraladi va ornitin qayta tiklanadi.

ch70-f40.text: Moçevina hosil bölgaç, jigar hujayralaridan tana suyuqliklariga diffuziyalanadi va buyraklar orqali çiqariladi.

ch70-f41.text: Aminokislotadan aminoguruh ajralgaç, qolgan ketokislota aksariyat hollarda metabolizm uçun energiya beriş maqsadida oksidlanişi mumkin. Bu odatda ikki bosqiçda keçadi. 1. Ketokislota limon kislotasi sikliga kira oladigan birikmaga aylanadi. 2. U siklda parçalanib, uglevod va lipid metabolizmidan hosil bölgan atsetil-KoA kabi energiya beradi (68- va 69-boblar). Bir gramm oqsil oksidlanganda hosil böladigan ATP miqdori odatda bir gramm glukoza oksidlangandagidan biroz kam.

ch70-f42.text: Ayrim dezaminlangan aminokislotalar, asosan jigarda, glukoza yoki yoğ kislotalari sintezida işlatiladigan substratlarga öxşaydi. Masalan, alanin piruvatga aylanadi. Undan glukoza yoki glikogen, boşqa yöl bilan esa yoğ kislotalariga aylana oladigan atsetil-KoA hosil böladi. Ikki atsetil-KoA birikib, keton tanaçalaridan biri bölgan atsetosirka kislotasini ham hosil qilişi mumkin (69-bob).

ch70-f43.text: Aminokislotalardan glukoza yoki glikogen hosil bölişi _glukoneogenez_ deyiladi. Darslikda ularning ketokislotalar yoki yoğ kislotasi boşlanğiç moddalariga aylanişi _ketogenez_ bilan boğliq holda bayon qilinadi. Keltirilgan hisobga köra, yigirmata dezaminlangan aminokislotaning 18 tasi glukozaga, 19 tasi yoğ kislotalariga aylanişi mumkin.

ch70-f44.text: Odam ratsionida oqsil bölmasa, tana oqsillarining bir qismi aminokislotalarga parçalanadi. Ular dezaminlanib, oksidlanadi. Sutkasiga 20–30 g oqsilga teng bu sarf _oqsilning muqarrar yöqotilişi_ deyiladi. Darslik örtaça odam uçun sof oqsil yöqotilişini qoplaşga kamida 20–30 g oqsil kerakligini, ehtiyoj muşak massasi, faollik va yoşga qarab özgarişini qayd etadi. Unda ehtiyot zaxirasi bilan sutkasiga 60–75 g miqdor keltirilgan.

ch70-f45.text: Ovqat oqsilidan yangi töqima oqsili sintezida töliq foydalaniş uçun undagi aminokislotalar nisbati töqimadagiga yaqin bölişi kerak. Bitta almaşinmaydigan aminokislota yetişmasa, boşqalaridan töliq foydalanib bölmaydi, çunki hujayra oqsilni butun zanjir şaklida sintezlaydi (3-bob). Işlatilmagan aminokislotalar dezaminlanadi va oksidlanadi. Aminokislotalar nisbati organizmning örtaça oqsilidan ança farq qiluvçi oqsil _töliq bölmagan oqsil_ deyiladi. Uning oziq qiymati _töliq oqsilnikidan_ pastroq.

ch70-f46.text: Sutkalik 20–30 g muqarrar oqsil sarfidan taşqari, uglevod va yoğ yetarli bölsa, energiya deyarli butunlay ulardan olinadi. Bir neça hafta oçlikdan söng bu zaxiralar tugay boşlaganda qondagi aminokislotalar energiya uçun tez dezaminlanib oksidlanadi. Şu bosqiçda töqima oqsillari sutkasiga 125 g gaça tezlikda parçalanişi va hujayra vazifalari keskin yomonlaşişi mumkin. Energiya uçun avval uglevod hamda yoğ işlatilişi sababli ular _oqsilni tejovçi moddalar_ deb ataladi.

ch70-f47.text: Ösiş gormoni töqimalardagi oqsillarni köpaytiradi. Aniq mexanizm töliq aniqlanmagan. Aminokislotalarning membrana orqali taşilişi ortişi, oqsil sintezi bilan boğliq transkripsiya va translyatsiyaning tezlaşişi hamda töqima oqsillari oksidlanişining kamayişi muhim deb hisoblanadi.
ch70-f47.lead: Ösiş gormoni hujayra oqsillari sintezini oşiradi.

ch70-f48.text: Insulin butunlay yetişmasa, oqsil sintezi deyarli nolga tuşadi. Insulin ayrim aminokislotalarning hujayraga taşilişini tezlaştiradi va şu yöl bilan sintezni rağbatlantirişi mumkin. U oqsil parçalanişini kamaytiradi va hujayralarga köproq glukoza yetkazilişiga yordam beradi. Natijada energiya uçun aminokislotalarga ehtiyoj tuşadi.

ch70-f49.text: Buyrak usti bezlari pöstloği glukokortikoidlari _köpçilik_ töqimalarda oqsil miqdorini _kamaytiradi_, şu bilan birga plazma aminokislotalari, _jigar oqsillari va plazma oqsillarini_ köpaytiradi. Jigardan taşqaridagi oqsillar köproq parçalanganda tana suyuqliklarida aminokislotalar ortadi. Jigar ulardan hujayra va plazma oqsillarini köproq sintezlay oladi.
ch70-f49.lead: Glukokortikoidlar köpçilik töqima oqsillarining parçalanişini kuçaytiradi.

ch70-f50.text: Erkak jinsiy gormoni testosteron tananing köp töqimalarida, ayniqsa muşaklarning qisqaruvçi oqsillarida oqsil töplanişini oşiradi. Darslikda muşak oqsillarining 30–50 foiz ortişi keltirilgan. Mexanizm töliq aniqlanmagan va ösiş gormoninikidan farq qiladi. Ösiş gormoni ta’sirida töqima uzoq vaqt ösişda davom etişi mumkin. Testosteron ta’sirida esa muşaklar va kamroq darajada boşqa oqsilga boy töqimalar faqat bir neça oy kattalaşadi. Ular çegarasiga yetgaç, testosteron beriş davom etsa ham qöşimça oqsil töplanişi töxtaydi.

ch70-f51.text: Asosiy ayol jinsiy gormoni estrogen ham oqsil töplanişini bir oz oşiradi. Uning ta’siri testosteronnikidan ança kuçsiz.

ch70-f52.text: Tiroksin umumiy hujayra metabolizmini oşiriş orqali oqsilga bilvosita ta’sir qiladi. Energiya uçun uglevod va yoğ yetişmasa, oqsillar tez parçalanib, energiya uçun işlatiladi. Uglevod va yoğ yetarli, hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikda aminokislota köp bölsa, tiroksin oqsil sintezini tezlaştirişi mumkin. Ösayotgan hayvon yoki odamda tiroksin yetişmasligi oqsil sintezi yetarli bölmagani sababli ösişni keskin susaytiradi. Tiroksin oqsil metabolizmiga kuçli maxsus ta’sirdan köra, uning odatdagi anabolik va katabolik reaksiyalarini tezlaştiruvçi umumiy ta’sir körsatadi.
